fee_notes: Brand Development Fund: up to 2% of Gross Sales (currently assessed at 2%). Franchisee Directed Local Marketing: additional 2% of Gross Sales spent locally on pre-approved marketing (not paid to franchisor). Technology Fee: up to $500/month, currently not assessed. Online Ordering/Rewards/Gift Cards: not currently implemented but may be implemented in the future. POS System: varies, monthly as invoiced (currently Clover). Local/Regional Advertising Cooperative: not to exceed local marketing requirement, currently not assessed. Annual Conference Fee: up to $1,200. Additional Employee Initial Training: currently $5,000 (not to increase more than 25% annually). Supplemental On-Site Training: $800 per trainer per day plus expenses, two-day minimum. Interest on overdue amounts: 18% per annum. Reporting Non-Compliance: $150/occurrence. Operations Non-Compliance: $450–$1,000/occurrence. Payment Non-Compliance: $150/occurrence. NSF/Failed EFT: 5% of amount or $50, whichever is greater. Transfer fee: $15,000. Renewal fee: $10,000.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty (Notes 2 and 3) 5% of Gross Sales Monthly on the 7th of each month for the preceding month
Brand Development Fund (Note 4) Up to 2% of Gross Sales Monthly on the 7th of each month for the preceding month
Franchisee Directed Local Marketing (Note 5) 2% of Gross Sales As incurred Must be spent by you monthly on pre-approved marketing within your designated territory.
POS System (Note 6) Varies under the circumstances Monthly as invoiced Monthly license for point-of-sale system.
Online Ordering, Customer Rewards, and Gift Cards (Note 7) Currently not implemented by us but may be implemented in the future As invoiced and as incurred
Technology (Note 8) Up to $500 per month, currently not assessed Monthly as invoiced
Local and Regional Advertising Cooperatives (Note 9) Established by cooperative members, but not exceeding the local marketing requirement, currently not assessed As established by cooperative members
Annual Conference Attendance Fee (Note 10) Our then current conference fee, not greater than $1,200 When invoiced and before conference
Additional Employee Initial Training (Note 11) Our then current training fee, currently $5,000. This fee will not increase more than 25% annually. When invoiced and prior to training
Supplemental On-Site Training (Note 12) Our then current daily rate per trainer, plus expenses we incur. Current rate is $800 per trainer per day. When invoiced and prior to training
Interest 18% per annum from due date On demand
Reporting Non-Compliance $150 per occurrence 14 days of invoice
Operations Non-Compliance $450 to $1,000 per occurrence 14 days of invoice
Payment Non-Compliance $150 per occurrence 14 days of invoice
Audit Reimbursement of Actual Costs of Audit On demand
Quality Assurance Audit Reimbursement of Actual Costs of Quality Assurance Audit As invoiced
Collections Reimbursement of Actual Costs of Collections On demand
NSF Check Fee or Failed Electronic Fund Transfer 5% of amount or $50, whichever is greater, or maximum fee allowed by law On demand
Non-Compliance Actual fees, costs, and expenses On demand
Supplier Evaluation Reimbursement of Actual Costs of Supplier Review Within 14 days of invoice
Management Service Reimbursement of Actual Costs of Management Service As invoiced
Transfer $15,000 On demand
Renewal $10,000 On signing renewal Franchise Agreement
